rollups.text: Caroline’s adoption journey: On 2023-05-25, Caroline researched adoption agencies and chose an unnamed agency for its support of LGBTQ+ adopters; she described her dream of giving children in need a loving home. On 2023-07-14, an adoption council meeting strengthened her determination (50 days after the agency research). By 2023-08-23, she had applied to adoption agencies and attended an adoption advice and assistance group (40 days after the council meeting). On 2023-10-13, she had contacted her mentor for advice and said she felt ready to become a mother (51 days after applying). On 2023-10-20, she passed the agency interviews, a major step toward building a family (7 days later).

Caroline’s interest in counseling and mental-health work developed over time. On 2023-05-08, she said she planned to continue her education and explore careers, especially counseling or mental-health work. On 2023-06-23, she attended an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop about therapeutic methods and working effectively with trans people; by 2023-06-27, she was considering supporting trans people’s self-acceptance and mental health. On 2023-07-03 and 2023-07-06, she remained motivated to pursue this work, describing it as challenging but rewarding. On 2023-07-12, she was looking into jobs in the field, motivated by her own experience of receiving helpful mental-health support. The records show exploration and interest, not a decision to enter the profession.

Caroline’s LGBTQ+ youth support: On 2023-07-15 or 2023-07-16, she joined an LGBTQ youth mentorship program. By 2023-07-17, she was mentoring a transgender teenager, working with the teen on confidence and positive strategies. Caroline and her mentee attended an LGBT Pride event in June 2023, where the mentee’s happiness at seeing community support especially moved Caroline. By 2023-08-28, Caroline had also volunteered at an LGBTQ+ youth center, shared her story with young people, and formed strong connections there. She found the work powerful and fulfilling and intended to continue volunteering. A talent show for the center’s young people was being organized for September 2023.

Caroline’s LGBTQ+ art-show plans changed from an August 2023 show, which she was excited about, to a September 2023 show. On 2023-07-17, she shared a tree-and-sun painting made after visiting an LGBTQ+ center, intended to represent the unity and strength of its people. By 2023-08-25, she was putting together a September show of her paintings; she said it would feature LGBTQ+ artists and promote understanding and acceptance. The records do not confirm whether either planned show took place.

Caroline’s visual-art activities and works mentioned across the records: around 2023-07-17, she shared a tree-and-sun painting inspired by an LGBTQ+ center and intended for an art show; on 2023-08-14, she shared a painting titled “Embracing Identity”; on 2023-08-23, she shared a self-portrait of a woman with a blue face, made the previous week; during the week before 2023-08-25, she painted a beach sunset; on 2023-08-25, she discussed stained-glass works for a local church about time, growth, change, and her transgender journey, and shared flower paintings and drawings; on 2023-09-13, she shared a red-and-blue painting about gender binaries and her path as a trans woman; on 2023-10-13, she shared a drawing of a woman in a dress representing freedom and embracing womanhood, and said she had recently been trying abstract art. Caroline has said art helps her express feelings, explore and accept her gender identity, and bring joy.

Caroline attended several LGBTQ+ community events: an LGBTQ support group on 2023-05-07, which she found powerful and accepting; an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop on 2023-06-23; a Pride parade during the week of 2023-06-26 to 2023-07-02, which made her feel she belonged; an LGBTQ+ conference on 2023-07-10, where she connected with people with similar journeys; a Pride parade on 2023-08-11, which inspired her to keep fighting for LGBTQ+ rights; and a transgender poetry reading on 2023-10-06, which she later described as a safe, empowering place for people to share their stories. Caroline also recalled attending a Pride festival with Melanie in 2022.

Caroline’s music activities and interests: she began playing acoustic guitar around 2018 and mostly plays guitar, which she says helps her release emotions; on 2023-08-28, she described playing and singing as cathartic and uplifting. She also said Sara Bareilles’s “Brave” is especially meaningful to her because its themes of courage and doing what is right remind her of her journey and progress.

Caroline’s recurring public and community advocacy: during the week before 2023-06-09, she spoke at a school event about her transgender journey and encouraged students to engage with the LGBTQ community; on 2023-07-18, she joined Connected LGBTQ Activists, a group that meets and organizes events and campaigns; on 2023-08-14, she described using her art to represent inclusivity and speak up for LGBTQ+ acceptance. She has repeatedly said she wants to use her story and voice to promote understanding, inclusion, and trans rights.

Caroline’s adoption plans advanced through at least five recorded milestones: researching and choosing an LGBTQ+-inclusive agency on 2023-05-25; attending an adoption council meeting on 2023-07-14; applying to adoption agencies by 2023-08-23; contacting her mentor for advice by 2023-10-13; and passing agency interviews on 2023-10-20.

Melanie’s recurring visual-art activities and works: she painted a lake sunrise in 2022 (D1:14); painted nature-inspired pictures with her children, including a sunset with a palm tree, around 2023-07-08..2023-07-09 (D8:6, D8:8); made a blue-and-yellow painting with her children by 2023-07-17 (D9:13, D9:17); painted a horse on a wooden wall on 2023-08-23 (D13:8, D13:10); made a sunflower painting and planned autumn paintings on 2023-08-25 (D14:30, D14:32); made a pink-sky sunset painting around 2023-10-02..2023-10-08 (D17:12); and made an abstract painting with peaceful blue streaks by 2023-10-13 (D17:14, D17:16). Melanie said painting helps her express feelings and relax (2023-05-08; D1:16), and later described art as a sanctuary, comfort, and creative therapy (2023-08-17 and 2023-09-13; D12:7, D12:8, D16:8, D16:10). Her favorite painting subjects are landscapes and still life (2023-08-25; D14:30).

Melanie repeatedly took pottery classes and made pottery: she signed up for a class on 2023-07-02 and made a black-and-white flower-design bowl by 2023-07-03 (D5:4, D5:6); made pots with her children at a workshop on 2023-07-14, including a cup decorated with a dog face (D8:2, D8:4); showed a colorful patterned bowl on 2023-08-17 (D12:2, D12:3, D12:4); made a pottery piece on 2023-08-24 and shared a flower-decorated plate by 2023-08-25 (D14:2, D14:4); and described painting and pottery as her creative muses and forms of therapy on 2023-09-13 (D16:8, D16:10). Melanie finds pottery calming, relaxing, and emotionally expressive, and said it is a major part of her life, not merely a hobby (2023-07-02; D5:4, D5:10).

Melanie’s family camping and nature outings include a mountain camping trip during 2023-06-19..2023-06-25, with hiking, exploring nature, and campfire marshmallows (D4:6, D4:7, D4:8); a beach camping trip with her family by 2023-07-12 (D6:16); another forest camping trip mentioned on 2023-07-15 (D8:28, D8:29); a family camping trip around 2023-07-01..2023-07-02 (D9:1); an annual summer camping tradition described on 2023-07-20 (D10:12); and a family camping trip a few weeks before 2023-09-13, involving forest exploration, hiking, marshmallows, and campfire stories (D16:2, D16:4). Melanie recalled the family’s 2022 camping trip to watch the Perseid meteor shower (D10:14). She also took her children to a museum on 2023-07-05 (D6:4, D6:6), the beach by 2023-07-20 (D10:8, D10:10), a park on 2023-08-27 (D15:2), and outdoors on 2023-10-19 after a road trip (D18:16, D18:17). She values these shared family experiences and finds nature restorative (D4:10, D18:19, D18:21).

Melanie said her household had a dog and a cat on 2023-07-12; she said Luna and Oliver were sweet and playful, but did not specify which name belonged to which animal (D7:16, D7:17, D7:18). By 2023-08-23, the household had also acquired another cat named Bailey; Melanie said her pets were doing well (D13:4). Melanie shared a photo described as Oliver, depicting a black dog with a frisbee, and recalled that Oliver once hid his bone in her slipper (D13:6).

Melanie’s music-related interests include playing clarinet, which she began learning when young and uses for self-expression and relaxation (2023-08-28; D15:26); enjoying classical music by Bach and Mozart and modern music including Ed Sheeran’s “Perfect” (2023-08-28; D15:28); and attending a Matt Patterson concert for her daughter’s birthday on 2023-08-13 (D11:1, D11:2). On 2023-08-28, she attended a Summer Sounds concert featuring lively pop music and said music brings people together (D15:14, D15:16).

Melanie’s pottery practice was interrupted by an injury sometime in September 2023. By 2023-10-13, after roughly two to six weeks away from pottery, she said she was doing okay but that the break had been tough; while recovering, she kept busy reading a book Caroline had recommended and painting, including a calming sunset painting made around 2023-10-02..2023-10-08. The records do not establish when she returned to pottery.

On 2023-10-13, after hearing about a friend’s adoption of a child in 2022, Melanie said the friend’s long process and happiness had made her consider adopting herself. Caroline advised her to research adoption agencies or lawyers, gather references and financial and medical information, and prepare emotionally for a possible wait, offering to help. Melanie said she would research adoption and prepare emotionally. No later adoption application or decision by Melanie is recorded here.

Melanie said she and her children usually visit the beach only once or twice a year, making the outings special occasions to relax and spend time together (2023-07-20). Her family looks forward to an annual summer camping trip (2023-07-20).
